messages:
Jamie: Kicking off a live Q&A thread for GTM items — drop short questions about deal cadence, pricing/packaging, and partner plays. Maria and Leah will answer first. :mega:
Maria: Quick context — pipeline in Q2 is healthy but weighted toward mid-market. We have 12 deals >$250k in late stage but a longer average sales cycle (92 days). Ask specifics and I’ll share actions.
Sanjay: Question — are we changing the discounting guardrails for renewals vs net-new this quarter? We’re seeing multiple comps asking for higher discounts.
Maria: Short answer: no blanket increase. We approved a temporary discretionary uplift for strategic enterprise deals up to 5% with CSM/sales ops approval. Need legal signoff for anything beyond that. We want to protect unit economics.
Leah: Partner question — timeline for the reseller program update? Customers are asking about VAR/reseller enablement in EMEA.
Leah: We’re launching the new "Partner Growth" tier on May 15. Highlights: 15% revenue share for certified resellers, co-sell credits for sourced deals, and a joint-marketing fund pilot for 8 partners. Docs + enablement kit will be available next week.
Darren: Will the partner fund require minimum monthly commit? Some partners prefer no-commit programs.
Leah: Pilot has a soft commit: partners need to register 3 qualified opportunities per quarter to be eligible for co-marketing dollars. No monetary commit up front.
Olivia: On packaging — are we moving to explicit "reserved capacity" SKUs for Dedicated, or keeping per-token pricing with committed discounts? This impacts how product docs and plans are shown.
Maria: We’ll offer both. Dedicated will have reserved-capacity SKUs (monthly tiers with slots) plus a per-token overage rate. Hosted tiers keep per-token pricing but with volume breakpoints. Sales should use the SKU matrix in the enablement deck (link in #sales later).
Sanjay: How should AEs position quantization/cost-optimizations? Ops asks for a simple line to include in proposals.
Olivia: Use this framing: "We provide model/quantization profiles that reduce inference costs by up to 40% for high-throughput workloads while preserving output quality; we can recommend a profile during onboarding." Keep it non-technical for exec buyers.
Jamie: On forecasting — shift to weekly rollups for top 25 deals starting this Friday. Sales leadership, please push updated RFC by EOD tomorrow. This will improve our roll rate visibility. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maria: Action items from thread: 1) Leah to drop partner launch kit + FAQ (by next Monday). 2) Olivia to draft one-line cost optimization blurb for proposals (today). 3) Sales ops to publish SKU matrix and discount guardrails (tomorrow).
Sanjay: Thanks — can we get a short slide for all-hands next week summarizing the partner tiers? Would help international reps.
Leah: Yep — I’ll drop a 2-slide summary in #all-hands-decks and ping product marketing.
all-hands-bot: Note — recording and slides will be uploaded to the all-hands folder within 24h.
Jamie: Appreciate the questions. If folks want follow-ups, ping Maria/Leah directly or add to this thread. We’ll do a brief GTM sync in next week’s leadership huddle to track progress. :v:
